title: Why people are reluctant to tempt fate
central_claims: People intuitively think tempting fate increases negative outcome likelihood, mediated by heightened accessibility of negative possibilities.

source_manifest.title: Many Labs2: Investigating Variation in Replicability Across Samples and Settings
source_manifest.finding: Tempting fate raised expected negative-outcome likelihood in N=8000,d=.18;the preregistered undergraduate subsample gave d=.22. Mechanistic accessibility mediation was not retested.
